blind.description: A stylized low rectangular wooden storage trough or crate filled with sand/dirt, holding neatly arranged root crops (bright orange carrots and dark magenta beetroots/turnips with green leaf stems) clamped in sand, along with a carved wooden scoop resting at one side. The wooden frame has reinforced corner posts and sturdy bottom runner feet. Surfaces are clean, solid, and hand-painted in stylized textures without disconnected flakes or melted parts.
blind.from_above: A rectangular wooden border filled with sandy soil, showing organized rows of round root vegetable tops (a row of orange carrots, a mixed row with beets, carrots, and a wooden scoop, and a row of purple beets).
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1.5 feet tall (less than one-third the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and roughly 3.5 to 4 feet long.
